name: review-paper
description: Peer reviews of others' papers in Hang Yu's reviewing style, on a review page with the evidence under each point and buttons to accept, edit, or reject it. Also proposes edits to a manuscript's text on the editing page when asked.

interface.shortDescription: Draft a peer review in Hang's reviewing style
interface.longDescription: Peer reviews of others' papers in Hang Yu's reviewing style, on a review page with the evidence under each point and buttons to accept, edit, or reject it. Also proposes edits to a manuscript's text on the editing page when asked. It needs the writing-style and html-templates plugins from the same marketplace.
defaultPrompt: Use $review-paper to draft a peer review of this manuscript on the review page, with evidence under each point for me to accept, edit, or reject.
